meta.name: The Saint Of Second Chances
meta.description: Mike Veeck, son of MLB franchise owner Bill Veeck, blows up his father's career. Exiled from the game he loves, the younger Veeck spends the next few decades clawing his way up from rock bottom, determined to redeem himself.
meta.slogan: A baseball dynasty built on fun — and a disco disaster that nearly undid it all.
